    magic = data[0:4]
    print('Magic:', magic.hex())
    # Version: 4 bytes
    version = struct.unpack('<I', data[4:8])[0]
    print('Version:', version)
    # Flags: 4 bytes
    flags = struct.unpack('<I', data[8:12])[0]

    # Count: 4 bytes
    count = struct.unpack('<I', data[12:16])[0]
    print('Count:', count)

    # Path length: 4 bytes
    path_len = struct.unpack('<I', data[16:20])[0]

    print('Path:', path)

    score = struct.unpack('>Q', data[20+path_len:20+path_len+8])[0]
    print('Score:', score)
